name: REN - DEV - OPS-09 - Pilot Observability Alerts_quicklink

parameters.content:
## OPS-09 - Pilot Observability Alerts

Dos ingresos:
- cada 5 minutos agrega fallos terminales y colas estancadas;
- Error Trigger recibe fallos no controlados de workflows críticos.

Envía solo métricas agregadas a `RENOV_OBSERVABILITY_ALERT_URL`, que debe ser HTTPS. La URL nunca entra en logs ni exports.

Callbacks Salesforce están excluidos de alertas mientras `WF-08` siga bloqueado; se habilitan con `RENOV_OBSERVABILITY_ALERT_CALLBACK_FAILURES=true`.

Dedupe durable: máximo una alerta de salud por combinación de categorías y hora; fallos de entrega se reintentan.

parameters.jsCode:
function env(name, fallback = '') {
    try { return String($env[name] || fallback).trim(); } catch (error) { return fallback; }
  }
  const rawWindow = env('RENOV_OBSERVABILITY_ALERT_WINDOW_MINUTES', '15');
  const windowMinutes = /^[0-9]{1,2}$/.test(rawWindow)
    ? Math.min(60, Math.max(5, Number(rawWindow)))
    : 15;
  const includeCallbacks = env('RENOV_OBSERVABILITY_ALERT_CALLBACK_FAILURES', 'false').toLowerCase() === 'true';
  return [{ json: {
    health_sql: "WITH config AS (
  SELECT
    LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE($1::integer, 15), 5), 60) AS window_minutes,
    COALESCE($2::boolean, false) AS include_callback_alerts,
    now() AS generated_at
), bounds AS (
  SELECT
    window_minutes,
    include_callback_alerts,
    generated_at,
    generated_at - make_interval(mins => window_minutes) AS starts_at
  FROM config
), recent_log_failures AS (
  SELECT count(*)::integer AS total
  FROM renovation_dev.interaction_logs, bounds
  WHERE created_at >= bounds.starts_at
    AND success = false
    AND event_type NOT IN (
      'pilot_observability_alert',
      'pilot_observability_alert_config_missing'
    )
), double_llm_failures AS (
  SELECT count(*)::integer AS total
  FROM renovation_dev.interaction_logs, bounds
  WHERE event_type = 'wf03b_chatwoot_waba_inbound'
    AND created_at >= bounds.starts_at
    AND payload #>> '{metadata,llm_fallback_used}' = 'true'
    AND payload #>> '{metadata,llm_provider}' IS NULL
), chatwoot_reply_not_found AS (
  SELECT count(*)::integer AS total
  FROM renovation_dev.interaction_logs, bounds
  WHERE event_type = 'wf03b_chatwoot_waba_inbound'
    AND created_at >= bounds.starts_at
    AND success = false
    AND payload->>'chatwoot_send_status' = '404'
), dispatch_failures AS (
  SELECT
    count(*) FILTER (
      WHERE status = 'failed' AND updated_at >= bounds.starts_at
    )::integer AS terminal,
    count(*) FILTER (
      WHERE status = 'queued'
        AND process_after < bounds.generated_at - interval '15 minutes'
        AND renovation_dev.is_automatic_send_allowed(bounds.generated_at)
    )::integer AS stalled
  FROM renovation_dev.quicklink_campaign_dispatches dispatch
  CROSS JOIN bounds
  WHERE dispatch.dev_simulate_http_status IS NULL
), callback_failures AS (
  SELECT
    count(*) FILTER (
      WHERE bounds.include_callback_alerts
        AND state = 'failed'
        AND updated_at >= bounds.starts_at
    )::integer AS terminal,
    count(*) FILTER (
      WHERE bounds.include_callback_alerts
        AND state = 'queued'
        AND process_after < bounds.generated_at - interval '15 minutes'
    )::integer AS stalled
  FROM renovation_dev.salesforce_callback_events, bounds
), handoff_operation_failures AS (
  SELECT
    count(*) FILTER (
      WHERE operation_status = 'running'
        AND started_at < bounds.generated_at - interval '15 minutes'
    )::integer AS stalled,
    count(*) FILTER (
      WHERE operation_status = 'uncertain'
    )::integer AS uncertain
  FROM renovation_dev.chatwoot_handoff_operations, bounds
), metrics AS (
  SELECT
    bounds.*,
    recent_log_failures.total AS interaction_failures,
    double_llm_failures.total AS double_llm_failures,
    chatwoot_reply_not_found.total AS chatwoot_reply_not_found,
    dispatch_failures.terminal AS dispatch_terminal_failures,
    dispatch_failures.stalled AS dispatch_stalled,
    callback_failures.terminal AS callback_terminal_failures,
    callback_failures.stalled AS callback_stalled,
    handoff_operation_failures.stalled AS handoff_operation_stalled,
    handoff_operation_failures.uncertain AS handoff_operation_uncertain
  FROM bounds
  CROSS JOIN recent_log_failures
  CROSS JOIN double_llm_failures
  CROSS JOIN chatwoot_reply_not_found
  CROSS JOIN dispatch_failures
  CROSS JOIN callback_failures
  CROSS JOIN handoff_operation_failures
), categorized AS (
  SELECT
    metrics.*,
    array_remove(ARRAY[
      CASE WHEN chatwoot_reply_not_found > 0 THEN 'chatwoot_reply_not_found' END,
      CASE WHEN interaction_failures > 0 THEN 'interaction_failures' END,
      CASE WHEN double_llm_failures > 0 THEN 'double_llm_failure' END,
      CASE WHEN dispatch_terminal_failures > 0 THEN 'dispatch_terminal_failure' END,
      CASE WHEN dispatch_stalled > 0 THEN 'dispatch_stalled' END,
      CASE WHEN callback_terminal_failures > 0 THEN 'callback_terminal_failure' END,
      CASE WHEN callback_stalled > 0 THEN 'callback_stalled' END,
      CASE WHEN handoff_operation_stalled > 0 THEN 'handoff_operation_stalled' END,
      CASE WHEN handoff_operation_uncertain > 0 THEN 'handoff_operation_uncertain' END
    ]::text[], NULL) AS categories
  FROM metrics
), keyed AS (
  SELECT
    categorized.*,
    CASE WHEN cardinality(categories) > 0 THEN
      'pilot-health:'
      || to_char(generated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYYMMDDHH24')
      || ':' || md5(array_to_string(categories, ','))
    ELSE NULL END AS alert_key
  FROM categorized
), notification_state AS (
  SELECT
    keyed.*,
    CASE WHEN keyed.alert_key IS NULL THEN false ELSE EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM renovation_dev.interaction_logs log
      WHERE log.event_type = 'pilot_observability_alert'
        AND log.correlation_id = keyed.alert_key
        AND log.success = true
    ) END AS already_notified
  FROM keyed
)
SELECT
  generated_at,
  starts_at,
  window_minutes,
  include_callback_alerts,
  cardinality(categories) > 0 AS alert_required,
  already_notified,
  alert_key,
  to_jsonb(categories) AS categories,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'interaction_failures', interaction_failures,
    'double_llm_failures', double_llm_failures,
    'chatwoot_reply_not_found', chatwoot_reply_not_found,
    'dispatch_terminal_failures', dispatch_terminal_failures,
    'dispatch_stalled', dispatch_stalled,
    'callback_terminal_failures', callback_terminal_failures,
    'callback_stalled', callback_stalled,
    'handoff_operation_stalled', handoff_operation_stalled,
    'handoff_operation_uncertain', handoff_operation_uncertain
  ) AS metrics
FROM notification_state",
    health_params: [windowMinutes, includeCallbacks],
  } }];

const prepared = $('IF - Send Observability Alert?').item.json || {};
  const response = $input.first().json || {};
  const status = Number(response.statusCode ?? response.status ?? 0);
  const success = Number.isInteger(status) && status >= 200 && status < 300;
  const payload = {
    project: 'renovaciones',
    environment: 'dev',
    alert_key: prepared.alert_key || null,
    alert_kind: prepared.alert_kind || null,
    categories: Array.isArray(prepared.alert_payload?.categories) ? prepared.alert_payload.categories : [],
    metrics: prepared.alert_payload?.metrics && typeof prepared.alert_payload.metrics === 'object'
      ? prepared.alert_payload.metrics
      : {},
    delivery_http_status: Number.isInteger(status) ? status : 0,
  };
  return [{ json: {
    alert_log_sql: "WITH input AS (
  SELECT
    $1::text AS event_type,
    $2::text AS correlation_id,
    $3::jsonb AS payload,
    $4::boolean AS success,
    NULLIF(left($5::text, 500), '') AS error_message,
    COALESCE($6::boolean, false) AS deduplicate
), inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO renovation_dev.interaction_logs (
    event_type,
    correlation_id,
    payload,
    success,
    error_message
  )
  SELECT
    event_type,
    correlation_id,
    payload,
    success,
    CASE WHEN success THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(error_message, 'OBSERVABILITY_ALERT_FAILED') END
  FROM input
  WHERE NOT deduplicate
     OR NOT EXISTS (
       SELECT 1
       FROM renovation_dev.interaction_logs existing
       WHERE existing.event_type = input.event_type
         AND existing.correlation_id = input.correlation_id
     )
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted) AS recorded",
    alert_log_params: [
      'pilot_observability_alert',
      prepared.alert_key || 'missing-alert-key',
      JSON.stringify(payload),
      success,
      success ? null : `ALERT_WEBHOOK_HTTP_${Number.isInteger(status) ? status : 0}`,
      false,
    ],
  } }];

const item = $input.first().json || {};
  const payload = {
    project: 'renovaciones',
    environment: 'dev',
    alert_key: item.alert_key || null,
    alert_kind: item.alert_kind || null,
    reason: 'alert_webhook_not_configured',
  };
  return [{ json: {
    alert_log_sql: "WITH input AS (
  SELECT
    $1::text AS event_type,
    $2::text AS correlation_id,
    $3::jsonb AS payload,
    $4::boolean AS success,
    NULLIF(left($5::text, 500), '') AS error_message,
    COALESCE($6::boolean, false) AS deduplicate
), inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO renovation_dev.interaction_logs (
    event_type,
    correlation_id,
    payload,
    success,
    error_message
  )
  SELECT
    event_type,
    correlation_id,
    payload,
    success,
    CASE WHEN success THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(error_message, 'OBSERVABILITY_ALERT_FAILED') END
  FROM input
  WHERE NOT deduplicate
     OR NOT EXISTS (
       SELECT 1
       FROM renovation_dev.interaction_logs existing
       WHERE existing.event_type = input.event_type
         AND existing.correlation_id = input.correlation_id
     )
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted) AS recorded",
    alert_log_params: [
      'pilot_observability_alert_config_missing',
      item.alert_key || 'missing-alert-key',
      JSON.stringify(payload),
      true,
      null,
      true,
    ],
  } }];
